Subject: Webhook disabled: hooks.example.com

Webhook disabled
================

The webhook endpoint to hooks.example.com of Lido Delfino was disabled automatically after 20 consecutive failed deliveries. Later events are no longer sent.

Check the service receiving the webhooks, then reactivate the endpoint in Settings › Integrations: the attempt history shows the response of every delivery.
